```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(sf) 
datos <- read.csv("datosmundo.csv")
head(datos)
names(datos)
summary(datos)
```
```{r}
datos <- rename(datos, sovereignt = X)
```
```{r}
mundo <- st_read("ne_110m_admin_0_countries.shp")
ggplot(mundo) + geom_sf()
```
```{r}
mundo.f <- inner_join(mundo, datos, by = "sovereignt")
```
```{r}
mundo.f.1990 <- filter(mundo.f, X.1 == 1990)
mundo.f.2013 <- filter(mundo.f, X.1 == 2013)
```
```{r}
gmundo1990 <- ggplot(mundo.f.1990, aes(fill = as.numeric(as.character(Life.expectancy.at.birth..years.)))) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Esperanza de Vida", low = "red", high = "blue", limits = c(30, 90)) +
  ggtitle("Esperanza de vida 1990") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + 
  xlab("Long") + ylab("Lat")


gmundo2013 <- ggplot(mundo.f.2013, aes(fill = as.numeric(as.character(Life.expectancy.at.birth..years.)))) +
  geom_sf() +
  scale_fill_gradient(name = "Esperanza de Vida", low = "red", high = "blue", limits = c(30, 90)) +
  ggtitle("Esperanza de vida 2013") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))+
  xlab("Long") + ylab("Lat")

gmundo1990
gmundo2013
```
